Banners include Recruit Assistant and Collect Memory Card. Each banner's unique banner consumables will be used first when pulling in the banners. Once those have been consumed, you can spend the event-only Diamonds to continue pulling.

◆ Recruit Assistant ◆
● Includes Standard Invitation, Golden Invitation, and Resplendent Invitation. The three invitation types will be unlocked in order as Venue Level increases.
● More Assistants will join the banner after Venue Level has been increased.
● Assistants obtained repeatedly will be converted to star-up EXP to increase that Assistant's star rating. If that Assistant is already at 5 stars, it will convert to a large amount of Gold Coins instead.
● Standard Invitation will grant at least 1 Assistant and Diamonds, with a <color=#f29e38ff>higher</color> chance of obtaining Trainee Assistants, <color=#f29e38ff>low</color> chance of obtaining Journeyman Assistants, and <color=#f29e38ff>very low</color> chance of obtaining Senior Assistants.
● Golden Invitation will grant at least 2 Assistants, Gold Coins, and Diamonds, with a <color=#f29e38ff>higher</color> chance of obtaining Trainee Assistants, <color=#f29e38ff>medium</color> chance of obtaining Journeyman Assistants, and <color=#f29e38ff>low</color> chance of obtaining Senior Assistants.
● Resplendent Invitation will grant at least 3 Assistants, Gold Coins, and Diamonds, with a <color=#f29e38ff>medium</color> chance of obtaining Trainee Assistants, <color=#f29e38ff>higher</color> chance of obtaining Journeyman Assistants, and <color=#f29e38ff>medium</color> chance of obtaining Senior Assistants.
● Golden Invitation will be unlocked when Venue Level reaches 3, and the multi-pull function for Standard Invitation will also be unlocked.
● Resplendent Invitation will be unlocked when Venue Level reaches 7, and the multi-pull function for Golden Invitation will also be unlocked.
● The multi-pull function for Resplendent Invitation will also be unlocked when Venue Level reaches 8.
● The multi-pull function allows you to use multiple tickets at once to quickly invite Assistants.

◆ Collect Memory Card ◆
● There are 4 banners, each themed after the four worlds the Express has passed. The four worlds will be unlocked in order as Venue Level increases.
● Each banner includes <unbreak>10</unbreak> Memory Cards, with 8 Normal Cards and 2 Rare Cards.
● Each Memory Cards include 3 fragments. Each pull can randomly yield 1 Memory Card fragment. All fragments have identical rates to be pulled.
● When all 3 fragments of 1 Memory Card are collected, you can combine them into a complete card and activate the card's Venue Buff effect.
● Memory Card fragments can be gained repeatedly. You can gift the extra copies to your friends or request their extra copies to help you quickly collect all Memory Cards.
